questions.title: Instance Variable Scope Per Object
questions.description: What does the following snippet print?
questions.codesnippet:
class Counter
  def initialize; @count = 0 end
  def inc; @count += 1 end
  def count; @count end
end
a = Counter.new
b = Counter.new
a.inc
a.inc
b.inc
puts a.count + b.count

questions.title: Class Variable Sharing Count
questions.description: What does the following snippet print?
questions.codesnippet:
class T
  @@count = 0
  def initialize; @@count += 1 end
  def self.count; @@count end
end
T.new; T.new; T.new
puts T.count

questions.title: self Receiver Method Call
questions.description: What does the following snippet print?
questions.codesnippet:
class Calc
  def initialize(v) @v = v end
  def double; self.add(@v) end
  def add(x); @v + x end
end
puts Calc.new(5).double

questions.title: Initialize Default Argument

  end
  def name; @name end
end
puts G.new.name
puts G.new("Y").name

questions.title: Attr Accessor Override Output
questions.description: What does the following snippet print? The class defines attr_accessor :v and then overrides the getter method v.
questions.codesnippet:
class A
  attr_accessor :v
  def initialize(v) @v = v end
  def v; @v * 2 end
end
a = A.new(3)
a.v = 5
puts a.v
